name: RIPE RIS Live (BGP updates)

volume.method: python websockets client, subscribed to type UPDATE with no filter, counted received messages
volume.note: Unfiltered firehose; 2.4 MB/s is about 210 GB/day raw, so any real run needs a collector, prefix or ASN filter.

reason: Highest measured volume of any keyless source and rarely used in portfolio projects.
project_fit: BGP withdrawals per country are an internet-disruption signal that can sit beside travel advisories and GDELT.

name: Polymarket CLOB market channel

volume.method: subscribed to the clobTokenIds of the top 100 markets by 24h volume from gamma-api.polymarket.com/markets, counted messages
volume.note: Rate depends on how many markets are subscribed; 100 markets is a choice, not a limit. Terms of use for redistribution not read.

reason: Prediction-market price changes on real events, read without credentials, at high volume.
project_fit: Market-implied probability of geopolitical events can be compared with official advisories and GDELT event counts.

name: Bluesky Jetstream

volume.method: python websockets client, no collection filter, counted received messages
volume.note: Needs an HTTP/1.1 upgrade; the HTTP/2 handshake returned 426. Two curated lists call the firehose authenticated, but Jetstream accepted the connection without credentials.

reason: High volume but a common portfolio source, so it does not separate the project.
project_fit: Fallback if the shortlisted sources fail; trending topics per language.

name: CertStream (certstream.dev)

volume.method: counted messages by message_type: 8469 dns_entries and 1 heartbeat in 15 s
volume.note: Hosted by a third party; the original calidog.io host was not tried. Availability is not guaranteed.

reason: High volume, but a security domain that does not match the data-platform roles in the job-search file.
project_fit: Newly issued TLS certificates for phishing-domain detection; only if the project turns to security.

name: HSL High-Frequency Positioning (Helsinki transit)

volume.method: paho-mqtt, topic /hfp/v2/journey/ongoing/vp/#, counted messages
volume.note: Vehicle position messages only; other topics under /hfp/v2 were not measured. A wss endpoint on mqtt.hsl.fi:443 also accepted a websocket upgrade.

reason: Whole-city fleet at real volume with no key, and an honest stream-processing workload (geofencing, schedule adherence, late events).
project_fit: Strongest pure streaming problem; weak story for a visitor beyond Helsinki buses.

name: Binance BTCUSDT trade stream

volume.method: python websockets client, one pair, counted trade messages
volume.note: One pair only; more pairs scale roughly linearly with the number of streams subscribed.

reason: Crypto trades are the most common first streaming project.
project_fit: None beyond a baseline for comparison.

name: Wikimedia EventStreams recentchange

volume.method: curl -N, counted lines starting with data:
volume.note: Other Wikimedia streams (page-create, revision-create) were not measured. One curated list wrongly marks this as needing a key.

reason: Real, free and true SSE, but the standard tutorial source for streaming projects.
project_fit: Safe fallback; edit wars and bot-versus-human share per wiki.

name: GDELT 2.0 event export files

volume.method: downloaded the 21:15 export zip (86,360 bytes) and counted 1353 rows, divided by the 15-minute slot
volume.note: lastupdate.txt listed the 21:30 file but it returned 404 when fetched, while the 21:15 file returned 200, so the pointer can run ahead of the data. The gkg file in the same slot is about 98 times larger zipped (7,548,702 against 76,858 bytes) and its rows were not counted.

reason: Export rate is low, but it is the only keyless global event source and its gkg file is far larger; kept as the enrichment stream, not as the headline volume.
project_fit: Per-country conflict and tone counts to join with advisories and market odds.

name: Binance all-market mini ticker

volume.method: python websockets client, counted messages
volume.note: One message per second, each an array of all changed pairs (about 14 KB), so message count understates the record count.

reason: One message per second; same crypto domain as the rejected trade stream.
project_fit: None.

name: Lichess TV feed

volume.method: curl -N, counted lines starting with {
volume.note: Single featured game at a time.

reason: One game at a time gives half an event per second.
project_fit: None.

name: Nostr public relays (kind 1 notes)

volume.method: REQ kinds [1] since now, counted EVENT messages: 2 on nos.lol and 1 on relay.damus.io
volume.note: relay.nostr.band timed out during the handshake. Public relays may throttle a subscription with no author filter, so the true network volume is probably higher than measured.

reason: Measured rate is about one event per 7 seconds on the relays reachable here.
project_fit: None unless many relays are aggregated.

name: Hacker News Firebase updates

volume.method: curl -N with Accept text/event-stream, counted data: lines
volume.note: Each event carries the changed item and profile ids, not the content.

reason: Two events in 20 seconds.
project_fit: None.

name: USGS earthquake feed

volume.method: counted features in the all_day feed: 224
volume.note: Polled GeoJSON, not a push stream.

reason: 224 events per day.
project_fit: Optional hazard overlay.

name: UK Carbon Intensity API

volume.method: read the endpoint once; it returns one value per 30-minute settlement period
volume.note: Regional endpoint not measured.

reason: One value every 30 minutes.
project_fit: None.

name: EMSC seismic portal websocket

volume.method: python websockets client, 60 s window, zero messages received
volume.note: Connected (101) but no event arrived in the window; a longer window could show an occasional event.

reason: Zero messages in 60 seconds.
project_fit: None.

name: UK FCDO foreign travel advice (Atom and content API)
publisher: UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office

volume.method: fetched the Atom feed (20 entries) and the France content API (134,435 bytes); change rate over time not measured
volume.note: Per-country JSON at gov.uk/api/content/foreign-travel-advice/<country>. Change rate needs a polling history to measure.

reason: Advisories change a few times a day at most, so it is reference state, not a stream.
project_fit: Slowly changing dimension and change-detection source for the advisory idea.

name: US State Department travel advisories (RSS)

volume.method: fetched once: 218 items, 552,140 bytes; change rate not measured
volume.note: The JSON on cadatacatalog.state.gov returned 403; the RSS works.

reason: A table of current advisories that changes rarely.
project_fit: Pairs with the FCDO feed to show where the two governments disagree.

name: OpenF1

volume.method: read the latest session record only (Race, Mexico City, 2026-11-01)
volume.note: A curated list says live data is free; whether live telemetry needs a key was not checked. Live volume exists only during sessions.

reason: Live telemetry would be bursty, available only on race weekends, and its auth was not tested.
project_fit: Sport telemetry; not tied to the shortlisted idea.

name: Digitraffic Finland (marine AIS, rail, road)

volume.method: paho-mqtt over wss with user digitraffic and password digitraffic returned Not authorized on the marine, road and rail brokers
volume.note: The marine REST locations endpoint worked, but only with Accept-Encoding gzip and a Digitraffic-User header. The MQTT credentials I tried were a guess from memory and were refused; the real ones were not looked up.

reason: The MQTT brokers refused the credentials I tried, so no stream was read.
project_fit: Ship positions in Finnish waters if the MQTT access works.

name: Mastodon public streaming (mastodon.social)

volume.method: curl -N returned HTTP 301 and no body; the redirect target was not followed with a streaming client
volume.note: One curated list says the public timeline needs no auth on many instances; this instance did not stream.

reason: No stream was read; the instance redirected.
project_fit: Only worth retrying on an instance that allows unauthenticated streaming.

name: Norwegian Coastal Administration AIS

volume.method: bash /dev/tcp connect with a 4 s timeout
volume.note: Connection closed from this machine; may be a network restriction, not a dead service.

reason: The connection was refused from here.
project_fit: Ship positions; same idea as Digitraffic.

name: ReliefWeb API

volume.method: v1 returned HTTP 410 saying it is decommissioned and to use v2; v2 was not called
volume.note: v2 access terms, including whether an approved appname is required, were not checked.

reason: The v1 API is gone and v2 was not tried.
project_fit: Humanitarian reports per country as a slow dimension.

name: GDELT DOC 2.0 API

volume.method: one query returned HTTP 429 asking for one request per 5 seconds
volume.note: Not a stream; the file dumps (gdelt-v2-export) cover the same data.

reason: Rate-limited query API; the file dumps are the right access path.
project_fit: None.

name: IODA internet outage detection

volume.method: not probed; keyless access and a 2 to 5 minute update interval come from third-party GitHub project descriptions in a web search
volume.note: Unverified secondhand.

reason: Known only from search results, not tested.
project_fit: Country-level internet outages to compare with the BGP signal.

volume.method: not probed; a guide in the web search says it needs a free API token
volume.note: Unverified secondhand.

reason: Needs a token and was not tested.

name: ACLED conflict event data

volume.method: not probed; a guide in the web search says event-level data needs a research-tier account and is lagged
